svg.title: One ticket, a complete event loop
svg.desc: The full events, ai, and blockchain profile path. TicketEventProducer atomically inserts a RECEIVED ticket and publishes TICKET_SUBMITTED to the ticket_event topic in Oracle TxEventQ. The AI consumer embeds the ticket, finds related tickets and policies, generates a summary, and commits ENRICHED assistance, event outcome, and queue acknowledgement together. Human review preserves the reviewed summary in blockchain history. APPROVED keeps the summary without generating another event or resolving the ticket. REJECTED requires written feedback: the dedicated feedback producer atomically saves the review, appends feedback to the ticket, resets it to RECEIVED, and publishes TICKET_FEEDBACK_SUBMITTED. The same consumer regenerates assistance using the previous summary and accumulated feedback. Both producer instances use the same configuration but own separate transaction connections. After bounded retries, or immediately for a nonretryable error, the consumer records FAILED and acknowledges the event; failed_ticket_event is a failure worklist, not a queue. Manual replay marks the original failure REPLAYED, resets the ticket, and publishes a new event preserving its type and causation. Each new published event has its own UUID; redelivered IDs with durable outcomes are skipped. Main coral arrows show normal delivery and the review loop; dashed arrows show failure and manual replay. All labels and arrows are visible without animation.
svg.text: One ticket, a complete event loop
Human feedback returns to the same TxEventQ consumer.
